title: Vassals
statementMd:
After conquering many cities, the king of Nlogonia has decided to reward his vassals for their loyalty and success in battle. The conquered territory consists of $n$ cities connected by bidirectional roads. He wants to divide it among $v$ vassals so that each vassal controls at least one city and each city is controlled by exactly one vassal.

However, the vassals are quick-tempered and will seize any excuse to quarrel. To keep the peace, the king imposes a rule: each city may have at most one road leading to a city controlled by a different vassal.

Fortunately, the cities form a tree: there is exactly one path between any pair of cities, and there are no road cycles.

The king is busy with his royal duties and has asked you, the finest programmer in Nlogonia, to determine whether such a division is possible. If it is, also provide a valid assignment of cities.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $t$ ($1 \le t \le 5 \times 10^{4}$), the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains two integers $n$ ($2 \le n \le 3 \times 10^{5}$) and $v$ ($1 \le v \le n$), the numbers of cities and vassals.

Each of the next $n-1$ lines contains two distinct integers $a$ and $b$ ($1 \leq a,b \leq n$), indicating a bidirectional road between cities $a$ and $b$. The roads are guaranteed to form a tree.

The sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $500000$.

## Output

Answer the test cases in input order.

If no valid division exists, print `NAO` (Portuguese for "no").

Otherwise, print `SIM` ("yes") on the first line. On the second line, print $n$ integers $c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_n$, where $c_i$ ($1 \leq c_i \leq v$) is the vassal controlling city $i$. Every vassal must control at least one city. If several valid assignments exist, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
征服了许多城市后，Nlogonia 的国王决定嘉奖他的封臣，以表彰他们的忠诚和战功。征服的领土由 𝑛n 座城市组成，城市之间通过双向道路相连。他希望将这些城市分给 𝑣v 位封臣，使每位封臣至少掌管一座城市，且每座城市恰好由一位封臣掌管。

然而，封臣们脾气暴躁，总会找各种借口争吵。为了维持和平，国王制定了一条规则：对于每座城市，通往其他封臣所掌管城市的道路至多有一条。

幸运的是，这些城市构成一棵树：任意两座城市之间恰好有一条路径，且道路不构成任何环。

国王忙于处理王室事务，因此请你这位 Nlogonia 最优秀的程序员判断，是否存在满足要求的分配方案。如果存在，还需要给出一种合法的城市分配方案。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 𝑡t (1≤𝑡≤5×1041≤t≤5×104)，表示测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 𝑛n (2≤𝑛≤3×1052≤n≤3×105) 和 𝑣v (1≤𝑣≤𝑛1≤v≤n)，分别表示城市数量和封臣数量。

接下来的 𝑛−1n−1 行，每行包含两个不同的整数 𝑎a 和 𝑏b (1≤𝑎,𝑏≤𝑛1≤a,b≤n)，表示城市 𝑎a 和 𝑏b 之间有一条双向道路。保证这些道路构成一棵树。

所有测试用例的 𝑛n 之和不超过 500000500000。

## 输出格式

按输入顺序回答各个测试用例。

如果不存在合法的分配方案，输出 `NAO`（葡萄牙语中的“否”）。

否则，第一行输出 `SIM`（“是”）。第二行输出 𝑛n 个整数 𝑐1,𝑐2,…,𝑐𝑛c1,c2,…,cn，其中 𝑐𝑖ci (1≤𝑐𝑖≤𝑣1≤ci≤v) 表示掌管城市 𝑖i 的封臣编号。每位封臣必须至少掌管一座城市。如果存在多种合法的分配方案，输出任意一种即可。
